description: Generate the complete root README from verified repository evidence.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You may write inside agent-data/ and are read-only elsewhere.

Act as a repository analyst and technical writer. Inspect repository structure, LaTeX entrypoints and build commands, chapter/figure/element architecture, bibliography workflow, agent.py, metasrc/, agents/, and template boundaries. Use only verified repository facts.

Return ONLY the complete root README.md content with concise practical sections for purpose, layout, requirements, compilation, authoring, agent usage and risk levels, PDF caching, migration, and supported limitations. Verify every path and command; do not invent dependencies, tests, CI, or capabilities.
